prompt.en: Which activity does Discover Canada say now provides a substantial part of Newfoundland and Labrador's economy?
prompt.fr: Selon Découvrir le Canada, quelle activité représente aujourd'hui une part importante de l'économie de Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador?

options.en: Taking oil and gas from wells off the coast.
options.fr: L'extraction de pétrole et de gaz au large des côtes.

options.en: Building cars and trucks in large assembly plants.
options.fr: La fabrication d'automobiles et de camions dans de grandes usines d'assemblage.
La culture de la pomme de terre.

explanation.en: The province has a unique heritage tied to the sea, and it has been known for its fisheries for a long time. Today, taking oil and gas from wells off its coast is a large part of its economy.
explanation.fr: La province a un patrimoine unique lié à la mer, et elle est connue depuis longtemps pour ses pêcheries. Aujourd'hui, l'extraction de pétrole et de gaz à partir de puits situés au large de ses côtes représente une part importante de son économie.

source.quote: Today off-shore oil and gas extraction contributes a substantial part of the economy.

verification.evidence: Newfoundland and Labrador is the most easterly point in North America and has its own time zone. In addition to its natural beauty, the province has a unique heritage linked to the sea. The oldest colony of the British Empire and a strategic prize in Canada’s early history, the province has long been known for its fisheries, coastal fishing villages and distinct culture. Today off-shore oil and gas extraction contributes a substantial part of the economy.
